svg.title: amp Now Playing showing album art default vs tapped states
svg.desc: Two side-by-side mockups of amp's Now Playing view. Both show the same updated layout: a back button in chrome, 200 by 200 album art, track title Idioteque by Radiohead with inline metadata, a green scrubber and timestamps, a transport row of five buttons Bluetooth-Prev-Play-Next-Loop where Bluetooth and Loop are navy-inverted active states, a single Lyrics button below transport centered, and a four-tab bar showing Mixes, Queue, Search, and Active with Active as the selected navy inversion. The only difference between the two frames is the album art: the left shows a stylized vinyl record graphic on near-black background, the right shows the same square flipped to reveal a dark navy background with five rows of track metadata: ALBUM Kid A, YEAR 2000, GENRE Electronic, TRACK 8 of 10, and FORMAT FLAC 320 kbps. The Track Info button has been removed since its functionality is now handled by tapping the album art.
